name: What is involved in jobsite cleanup and project closeout after a construction project?

mainEntity.name: What is involved in jobsite cleanup and project closeout after a construction project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Jobsite cleanup involves removing all construction debris, waste materials, and equipment from the site, leaving it tidy and safe. Project closeout includes a final inspection to ensure all work meets specifications, addressing any punch list items, and organizing final documentation such as warranties and permits. For Frasheski Construction, our process ensures a thorough final walkthrough with the client, especially in areas like Berkeley or Oakland, to confirm satisfaction before official handover.
acceptedAnswer.description: Jobsite cleanup removes debris; project closeout includes final inspections, punch lists, and documentation.
